main_text.head: SECT. VI. Quàm non admittant reconciliatio-nem reliquæ Romanæ Ecclesiæ opiniones.
main_text.p: LArgiamur tamen hæc no-bis, quod ipsi profecto nunquam sunt concessuri; Ad imperium enim se natam putat illa vetula vrbium mater,& aut ruet, aut dominabitur. Neque mitratus ille moderator orbis, aliud sibi mauult Emblema, quàm quod Iulio Cæsari iocosè appingit Iulia-nus (τὸ φῶς ωτέιvν) vel quod Alexandro(τὸ πάντα νικῶν): Apage autem Adrianum Sextum; cuius Iulian. Cæsare. tumulo

page.notes: The left-hand Greek fragments "τὸ φῶς ωτέιvν" and "τὸ πάντα νικῶν" are reproduced as legible; Greek accents are doubtful. The initial "L" is a large initial joined to "Argiamur". Show-through text from the reverse of the leaf is omitted. The line "tumulo" is the catchword-like word at the foot of the column and is probably the start of the next page's text; the text of the foot line "E 4" is a signature.
